meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的 claude-mem 观察记录构建知识语料库，加载进 AI 会话，并回答关于过去工作模式的问题；也能列出、重建或重新加载语料库。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史创建聚焦的“大脑”，询问过去的工作模式，或针对特定主题整理专业知识时。

say.text: 把关于 hooks 的观察整理成知识库。
say.note: 会执行 build_corpus 创建语料库。

say.text: 查询最近一个月的决策记录。
say.note: 会从语料库中检索答案。

say.text: 重建 hooks 语料库并重新加载。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build knowledge corpora from your claude-mem observation history, load them into an AI session, and answer questions about past work patterns. It can also list, rebuild, and reprime corpora.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create focused 'brains' from observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Compile observations about hooks into a knowledge base.
Query decision records from the last month.
Rebuild the hooks corpus and reload it.
